args.title: Persist export format selection in ExportButton
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Persist the selected export format in localStorage or session state so that when a report is opened, the previously chosen format is remembered instead of always resetting to CSV.

label: bug
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The export format selection resets to CSV every time because src/components/ExportButton.tsx manages the format state with useState without persisting it in storage.
